requirement.normalizedRequirement: The required minimum shell plate thickness, t, is given by: t = tnet + ts [mm] where tnet = plate thickness required to resist ice loads according to I2.4.2 [mm] ts = corrosion and abrasion allowance according to I2.11 [mm] The thickness of shell plating required to resist the design ice load, tnet, depends on the orientation of the framing.
requirement.source: UR I2 Structural Requirements for Polar Class Ships
